examples.hanzi: 他一气之下出走了，家人找了他一整夜。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīqì zhī xià chūzǒu le, jiārén zhǎo le tā yī zhěng yè.
examples.english: He stormed off in anger, and his family searched for him all night.

examples.hanzi: 这位国王被迫出走，再也没有回到故乡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi guówáng bèipò chūzǒu, zài yě méiyǒu huídào gùxiāng.
examples.english: The king was forced into exile and never returned home.

examples.hanzi: 台风预计明天凌晨登陆沿海地区。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng yùjì míngtiān língchén dēnglù yánhǎi dìqū.
examples.english: The typhoon is expected to make landfall on the coast early tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 这款手机下个月将登陆中国市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī xià gè yuè jiāng dēnglù Zhōngguó shìchǎng.
examples.english: This phone will be launched in the Chinese market next month.

examples.hanzi: 喝太多酒会伤害肝脏。
examples.pinyin: Hē tài duō jiǔ huì shānghài gānzàng.
examples.english: Drinking too much alcohol damages the liver.

examples.hanzi: 医生说他的肝脏有点问题，需要做进一步检查。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā de gānzàng yǒudiǎn wèntí, xūyào zuò jìnyībù jiǎnchá.
examples.english: The doctor said there is a problem with his liver and he needs further tests.

examples.hanzi: 你付款以后，店员会给你一张收据。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fùkuǎn yǐhòu, diànyuán huì gěi nǐ yī zhāng shōujù.
examples.english: After you pay, the clerk will give you a receipt.

examples.hanzi: 我把收据弄丢了，还能退货吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shōujù nòngdiū le, hái néng tuìhuò ma?
examples.english: I lost the receipt. Can I still return it?

examples.hanzi: 这个词在不同的场合有不同的含义。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cí zài bùtóng de chǎnghé yǒu bùtóng de hányì.
examples.english: This word has different meanings in different situations.

examples.hanzi: 你能解释一下这句话的含义吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng jiěshì yīxià zhè jù huà de hányì ma?
examples.english: Can you explain what this sentence means?

examples.hanzi: 传言说公司下个月要裁员。
examples.pinyin: Chuányán shuō gōngsī xià gè yuè yào cáiyuán.
examples.english: Rumor has it the company will lay off staff next month.

examples.hanzi: 别相信那些没有根据的传言。
examples.pinyin: Bié xiāngxìn nàxiē méiyǒu gēnjù de chuányán.
examples.english: Don't believe those groundless rumors.

examples.hanzi: 他每周去健身房的频率很高。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi zhōu qù jiànshēnfáng de pínlǜ hěn gāo.
examples.english: He goes to the gym very frequently every week.

examples.hanzi: 这种鸟的叫声频率很高，人耳几乎听不到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng niǎo de jiàoshēng pínlǜ hěn gāo, rén ěr jīhū tīng bù dào.
examples.english: This bird's call is so high in frequency that human ears can barely hear it.

examples.hanzi: 他在仓库里看守了一整夜。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài cāngkù lǐ kānshǒu le yī zhěng yè.
examples.english: He kept watch over the warehouse all night.

examples.hanzi: 牧羊人一直看守着山坡上的羊群。
examples.pinyin: Mùyángrén yīzhí kānshǒu zhe shānpō shàng de yángqún.
examples.english: The shepherd kept watching over the flock on the hillside.

examples.hanzi: 一位企业家资助了这个孩子上大学。
examples.pinyin: Yī wèi qǐyèjiā zīzhù le zhège háizi shàng dàxué.
examples.english: An entrepreneur funded this child's university education.

examples.hanzi: 这个项目需要有人资助才能继续下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào yǒurén zīzhù cáinéng jìxù xiàqù.
examples.english: This project needs someone to fund it before it can continue.

examples.hanzi: 谈判时，我们手里的筹码不多。
examples.pinyin: Tánpàn shí, wǒmen shǒu lǐ de chóumǎ bù duō.
examples.english: We don't have many bargaining chips in the negotiation.

examples.hanzi: 赌场里的筹码可以换成现金。
examples.pinyin: Dǔchǎng lǐ de chóumǎ kěyǐ huànchéng xiànjīn.
examples.english: Casino chips can be exchanged for cash.

examples.hanzi: 他老远跑来看我，我很感动。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǎoyuǎn pǎo lái kàn wǒ, wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: He came all that way to see me, and I was touched.

examples.hanzi: 声音从老远的地方传过来。
examples.pinyin: Shēngyīn cóng lǎoyuǎn de dìfang chuán guòlái.
examples.english: The sound came from far away.

examples.hanzi: 请把这份文件传递给下一位同事。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wénjiàn chuándì gěi xià yī wèi tóngshì.
examples.english: Please pass this document on to the next colleague.

examples.hanzi: 眼神也能传递很多信息。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnshén yě néng chuándì hěn duō xìnxī.
examples.english: Eye contact can also convey a lot of information.

examples.hanzi: 别再拖延了，今天就把事情做完吧。
examples.pinyin: Bié zài tuōyán le, jīntiān jiù bǎ shìqing zuò wán ba.
examples.english: Stop procrastinating and finish the job today.

examples.hanzi: 会议因为下雨被拖延了半个小时。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì yīnwèi xiàyǔ bèi tuōyán le bàn gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: The meeting was delayed by half an hour because of the rain.

examples.hanzi: 他的外套上别着一枚红色的徽章。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wàitào shàng bié zhe yī méi hóngsè de huīzhāng.
examples.english: He has a red badge pinned to his coat.

examples.hanzi: 每所大学都有自己的徽章。
examples.pinyin: Měi suǒ dàxué dōu yǒu zìjǐ de huīzhāng.
examples.english: Every university has its own emblem.

examples.hanzi: 这显然是一个骗局，千万别上当。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiǎnrán shì yī gè piànjú, qiānwàn bié shàngdàng.
examples.english: This is clearly a scam. Don't fall for it.

examples.hanzi: 老人差点被电话里的骗局骗走了存款。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén chàdiǎn bèi diànhuà lǐ de piànjú piànzǒu le cúnkuǎn.
examples.english: The old man almost lost his savings to a phone scam.

examples.hanzi: 以往这个时候，街上人很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǐwǎng zhège shíhou, jiē shàng rén hěn duō.
examples.english: In the past, the streets were crowded at this time.

examples.hanzi: 今年的成绩比以往任何一年都好。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng rènhé yī nián dōu hǎo.
examples.english: This year's results are better than any previous year.

examples.hanzi: 老人和孕妇可以优先上车。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén hé yùnfù kěyǐ yōuxiān shàngchē.
examples.english: Elderly people and pregnant women may board first.

examples.hanzi: 在这个公司，客户的需求永远优先。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège gōngsī, kèhù de xūqiú yǒngyuǎn yōuxiān.
examples.english: At this company, customers' needs always come first.

examples.hanzi: 我每天早上八点出门上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn chūmén shàngbān.
examples.english: I leave for work at eight every morning.

examples.hanzi: 电影八点开始，你别迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng bā diǎn kāishǐ, nǐ bié chídào le.
examples.english: The movie starts at eight, so don't be late.

examples.hanzi: 动物园里的大象特别受孩子们欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwùyuán lǐ de dàxiàng tèbié shòu háizimen huānyíng.
examples.english: The elephants at the zoo are especially popular with children.

examples.hanzi: 你去过北京动物园吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qùguo Běijīng dòngwùyuán ma?
examples.english: Have you ever been to the Beijing Zoo?

examples.hanzi: 她觉得一个人走夜路没有安全感。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde yī gè rén zǒu yèlù méiyǒu ānquángǎn.
examples.english: She feels unsafe walking alone at night.

examples.hanzi: 孩子需要父母给他足够的安全感。
examples.pinyin: Háizi xūyào fùmǔ gěi tā zúgòu de ānquángǎn.
examples.english: Children need their parents to give them enough of a sense of security.

examples.hanzi: 两支球队正在争夺冠军。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng zhī qiúduì zhèngzài zhēngduó guànjūn.
examples.english: The two teams are fighting for the championship.

examples.hanzi: 兄弟俩为争夺遗产吵了起来。
examples.pinyin: Xiōngdì liǎ wèi zhēngduó yíchǎn chǎo le qǐlái.
examples.english: The two brothers argued over the inheritance.

examples.hanzi: 我们打算暑假去沙漠探险。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎsuàn shǔjià qù shāmò tànxiǎn.
examples.english: We plan to go exploring in the desert this summer.

examples.hanzi: 这本书讲的是一次危险的探险经历。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū jiǎng de shì yī cì wēixiǎn de tànxiǎn jīnglì.
examples.english: This book is about a dangerous expedition.

examples.hanzi: 他请了一位有经验的辩护律师。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐng le yī wèi yǒu jīngyàn de biànhù lǜshī.
examples.english: He hired an experienced defense lawyer.

examples.hanzi: 辩护律师要求法庭重新调查这起案子。
examples.pinyin: Biànhù lǜshī yāoqiú fǎtíng chóngxīn diàochá zhè qǐ ànzi.
examples.english: The defense lawyer asked the court to reinvestigate the case.

examples.hanzi: 工人们正在路边挖掘一条水沟。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen zhèngzài lùbiān wājué yī tiáo shuǐgōu.
examples.english: Workers are digging a ditch by the road.

examples.hanzi: 老师鼓励我们挖掘自己的潜力。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gǔlì wǒmen wājué zìjǐ de qiánlì.
examples.english: The teacher encourages us to tap into our own potential.

examples.hanzi: 这部电影里有太多杀戮的画面。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng lǐ yǒu tài duō shālù de huàmiàn.
examples.english: This movie has too many scenes of slaughter.

examples.hanzi: 人们都希望这场杀戮早点结束。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen dōu xīwàng zhè chǎng shālù zǎodiǎn jiéshù.
examples.english: Everyone hopes the killing will end soon.

examples.hanzi: 我宁可走路，也不想挤公交车。

examples.english: I'd rather walk than squeeze onto the bus.

examples.english: She'd rather sleep less than leave her homework unfinished.

examples.english: We can't let bad people get away with it.

examples.pinyin: Tā fàn le zuì què yīzhí xiāoyáo fǎwài, dàjiā dōu hěn qìfèn.
examples.english: He committed a crime yet remains at large, and everyone is angry.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zài xiāngxia zhǎngdà.
examples.english: I grew up in the countryside as a child.

examples.pinyin: Xiāngxia de kōngqì bǐ chéng lǐ xīnxiān duō le.
examples.english: The air in the countryside is much fresher than in the city.

examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò fùyǔ le tā hěn dà de zérèn.
examples.english: This job has given her a great deal of responsibility.

examples.english: The author gave this character a new meaning.

examples.english: There are some topics everyone wants to steer clear of.

examples.hanzi: 他的朋友圈子很小，只有几个同学。

examples.english: His circle of friends is small, just a few classmates.

examples.pinyin: Háizi zài yuànzi lǐ rào zhe quānzi pǎo.
examples.english: The child ran in circles around the yard.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge shì yī míng ruǎnjiàn gōngchéngshī.
examples.english: My older brother is a software engineer.

examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gōngchéngshī jiǎnchá le suǒyǒu de jīqì.
examples.english: The engineer inspected all the machines.

examples.english: The robbers in the movie stole money from the bank.

examples.english: This story is a legend about a band of bandits.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen yīkuàir chīfàn, yīkuàir huíjiā.
examples.english: They eat together and go home together.

examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn de cáijué ràng shuāngfāng dōu hěn yìwài.
examples.english: The court's ruling surprised both sides.

examples.pinyin: Cáipàn duì zhè cì fànguī zuòchū le gōngzhèng de cáijué.
examples.english: The referee made a fair ruling on this foul.

examples.pinyin: Qìchē kuài méi ránliào le, wǒmen xiān qù jiāyóuzhàn ba.
examples.english: The car is almost out of fuel, so let's go to the gas station first.

examples.hanzi: 太阳能是一种不需要燃料的能源。
examples.pinyin: Tàiyángnéng shì yī zhǒng bù xūyào ránliào de néngyuán.
examples.english: Solar power is an energy source that needs no fuel.

examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiàn shì shàng, wǒ bù huì tuǒxié.
examples.english: I won't compromise on this matter.

examples.hanzi: 夫妻之间有时需要互相妥协。
examples.pinyin: Fūqī zhījiān yǒushí xūyào hùxiāng tuǒxié.
examples.english: Couples sometimes need to compromise with each other.

examples.hanzi: 欧洲大陆的天气最近很冷。
examples.pinyin: Ōuzhōu dàlù de tiānqì zuìjìn hěn lěng.
examples.english: The weather on the European continent has been cold lately.

examples.hanzi: 很多台湾人经常去大陆旅游。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō Táiwān rén jīngcháng qù dàlù lǚyóu.
examples.english: Many Taiwanese often travel to the mainland.

examples.pinyin: Tā hòuhuǐ le, juédìng zhǔdòng qù jǐngchájú zìshǒu.
examples.english: He regretted it and decided to turn himself in at the police station.

examples.hanzi: 主动自首的人通常会得到从轻处理。

examples.english: People who turn themselves in voluntarily usually receive a lighter sentence.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī hé cǎoméi zuò dàngāo.
examples.english: I want to buy a box of strawberries to make a cake.

examples.hanzi: 妹妹最喜欢草莓味的冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei zuì xǐhuan cǎoméi wèi de bīngqílín.
examples.english: My younger sister loves strawberry ice cream the most.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào jǐngtì nàxiē mòshēngrén fā lái de liànjiē.
examples.english: You should be wary of links sent by strangers.

examples.hanzi: 他的警惕性很高，一有动静就醒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jǐngtìxìng hěn gāo, yī yǒu dòngjìng jiù xǐng le.
examples.english: He is very alert and wakes at the slightest noise.

examples.hanzi: 小时候我最爱听中国神话故事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou wǒ zuì ài tīng Zhōngguó shénhuà gùshi.
examples.english: As a child I loved listening to Chinese myths.

examples.pinyin: Zhège suǒwèi de wánměi fāng'àn bùguò shì gè shénhuà.
examples.english: This so-called perfect plan is nothing but a myth.

examples.pinyin: Tā tóu de lánqiú liánxù sān cì mìngzhòng.
examples.english: His basketball shots hit the target three times in a row.

examples.pinyin: Zhè kē zǐdàn méiyǒu mìngzhòng mùbiāo.
examples.english: The bullet did not hit its target.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ shǔjià yǒu shénme jìhuà ma?
examples.english: Do you have any plans for the summer vacation?

examples.hanzi: 暑假作业我还没写完呢。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià zuòyè wǒ hái méi xiě wán ne.
examples.english: I haven't finished my summer homework yet.

examples.pinyin: Chāoshì měitiān dōu huì gōngyìng xīnxiān de shūcài.
examples.english: The supermarket supplies fresh vegetables every day.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn èrshísì xiǎoshí gōngyìng rèshuǐ.
examples.english: This hotel provides hot water twenty-four hours a day.

examples.pinyin: Tiānxià méiyǒu miǎnfèi de wǔcān.
examples.english: There's no such thing as a free lunch in this world.

examples.hanzi: 他的名声传遍了天下。
examples.pinyin: Tā de míngshēng chuánbiàn le tiānxià.
examples.english: His fame spread throughout the land.

examples.hanzi: 我没料到你会来参加聚会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi liàodào nǐ huì lái cānjiā jùhuì.
examples.english: I didn't expect you to come to the party.

examples.pinyin: Shéi néng liàodào shìqing huì biànchéng zhèyàng?
examples.english: Who could have predicted things would turn out like this?

examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu qīngróu de yīnyuè yǒu cuīmián de xiàoguǒ.
examples.english: This gentle music has a sleep-inducing effect.

examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī jiǎng de tài wúliáo, jiǎnzhí xiàng zài cuīmián wǒmen.
examples.english: The teacher is so boring it's practically lulling us to sleep.

examples.hanzi: 这张票只在当天有效。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng piào zhǐ zài dāngtiān yǒuxiào.
examples.english: This ticket is only valid on the day of issue.

examples.hanzi: 他当天晚上就坐飞机回国了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāngtiān wǎnshang jiù zuò fēijī huíguó le.
examples.english: He flew back to his home country that very evening.

examples.hanzi: 宝宝的脚趾又小又可爱。
examples.pinyin: Bǎobao de jiǎozhǐ yòu xiǎo yòu kě'ài.
examples.english: The baby's toes are tiny and cute.

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋太小了，挤得我的脚趾很疼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié tài xiǎo le, jǐ de wǒ de jiǎozhǐ hěn téng.
examples.english: These shoes are too small and squeeze my toes painfully.
